deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing gestures ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a spatial description ('The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that the text does not state or show to be correct.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: 'Circumspect' was replaced with 'circumscribed', which is the standard pathological term obviously intended by the speaker; this corrects an evident slip of the tongue/mishearing rather than distorting the teaching.

considerations.sourcePassage: And you can see here that this tumor, through the process of fixation and staining of this tumor, the hydration and dehydration of this tissue slice on the slide, has actually caused the tumor, which is, as I said, not invaded into the surrounding tissue to separate away from the normal muscle. So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The use of 'therefore' in 'The tumour is therefore circumscribed' reflects the lecturer's deduction ('So you can see again that...') rather than introducing an improper causal link.
